description: Convert a gold weight between gram, kilogram, troy ounce, pennyweight, grain, avoirdupois ounce, tola, Thai baht (bullion and jewellery), Vietnamese chi and luong, Hong Kong gold tael, Taiwan tael and China liang. Uses exact defined constants (1 troy ounce = 31.1034768 g, 1 grain = 64.79891 mg, NIST Handbook 44) and returns the definition and source of each unit. Omit "to" to get every unit.

from.description: Weight unit: gram, kilogram, troy_ounce, pennyweight, grain, avoirdupois_ounce, tola, baht, baht_jewelry, chi, tael, luong, tael_taiwan, tael_china. Aliases such as g, kg, oz, ozt, dwt and kilo work. "oz" means troy ounce.
